export declare const AGENT_RUNTIME_CAPABILITIES: readonly ["session.create", "session.read", "session.resume", "run.start", "run.observe", "run.control", "text-edit", "command", "command.receipts", "checkpoint", "rewind", "skills", "mcp", "subagents", "compaction", "usage"];

export interface AgentActionClient {
    discover(): Promise<readonly ActionView[]>;
    reader?: "work";
    delegate?: AgentDelegation;
    memory?: AgentMemoryTools;
    offer?(offer: AgentActionOffer): Promise<{
        offer_id: string;
    }>;
    check?(reference: ExactActionReference, input: unknown): Promise<void>;
    direct?(view: ActionView): boolean;
    invoke(reference: ExactActionReference, input: unknown, signal?: AbortSignal, memoryRead?: import("@molis-ai/molis-work-contracts/services/memory").MemoryRunReadControl): Promise<unknown>;
}

export interface AgentActionOffer {
    title: string;
    summary: string;
    reference: ExactActionReference;
    input: unknown;
    editable?: string[];
    missing?: Array<{
        field: string;
        question: string;
    }>;
}

export interface AgentBackgroundCapability {
    read(project: string, sessionId?: string): Promise<AgentBackgroundTask[]>;
    stop(project: string, taskId: string): Promise<boolean>;
}

export interface AgentBackgroundTask {
    task_id: string;
    session_id: string;
    run_id?: string;
    summary: string;
    state: "running" | "succeeded" | "failed" | "stopped" | "interrupted";
    exit_code?: number;
    started_at_ms: number;
    ended_at_ms?: number;
}

export type AgentCapabilitySupport = "supported" | "partial" | "unsupported";

    workspace: "business";

export interface AgentMemoryCandidateCapability {
    form(input: AgentMemoryFormationInput): Promise<AgentMemoryFormationResult>;
    propose(input: {
        scope: AgentMemoryEntry["scope"];
        owner: string;
        text: string;
        origin: string;
        tags?: string[];
        meta?: AgentMemoryMeta;
        sources?: AgentMemorySourceRef[];
        expected_version: 0;
        operation_id: string;
        signal?: AbortSignal;
    }): Promise<AgentMemoryCandidateEntry>;
    list(scope: AgentMemoryEntry["scope"], owner: string): Promise<AgentMemoryCandidateEntry[]>;
    get(input: AgentCandidateLocation & {
        signal?: AbortSignal;
    }): Promise<AgentMemoryCandidateEntry | undefined>;
    accept(input: AgentCandidateLocation & AgentMemoryMutation & {
        text?: string;
        origin?: string;
        meta?: AgentMemoryMeta;
    }): Promise<AgentMemoryEntry>;
    promote(input: AgentCandidateLocation & AgentMemoryMutation & {
        policy: string;
        version: number;
        origin?: string;
        meta?: AgentMemoryMeta;
    }): Promise<AgentMemoryEntry>;
    settleInto(input: AgentCandidateLocation & {
        candidate_expected_version: number;
        operation_id: string;
        signal?: AbortSignal;
        target: {
            memory_id: string;
            expected_version: number;
            change: AgentMemoryChange;
        };
        by: {
            by: "person";
        } | {
            by: "policy";
            policy: string;
            version: number;
        };
    }): Promise<AgentMemoryEntry>;
    discard(input: AgentCandidateLocation & AgentMemoryMutation): Promise<AgentMemoryCandidateEntry>;
    expire(input: AgentCandidateLocation & AgentMemoryMutation): Promise<AgentMemoryCandidateEntry>;
    reconcileDecision(input: AgentCandidateLocation & AgentMemoryMutation): Promise<AgentMemoryDecisionReceipt>;
    purge(input: AgentCandidateLocation & AgentMemoryMutation): Promise<void>;
}

export interface AgentMemoryCandidateEntry {
    candidate_id: string;
    version: number;
    sources?: AgentMemorySourceIdentity[];
    replacement?: {
        memory_id: string;
        expected_version: number;
    };
    suggested_basis?: "explicit" | "inferred";
    scope: AgentMemoryEntry["scope"];
    owner: string;
    text: string;
    origin: string;
    tags: string[];
    meta: AgentMemoryMeta;
    state: "pending" | "accepted" | "promoted" | "discarded" | "expired" | "cancelled";
    created_at_ms: number;
    settled_at_ms?: number;
    memory_id?: string;
}

export interface AgentMemoryCapability {
    withCaller(caller: AgentMemoryCaller): AgentMemoryCapability;

        change: AgentMemoryChange;

        reason: string;

        reason: string;

        expires_at_ms: number;

        keywords?: string[];

        kinds?: string[];
        limit?: number;
    }): Promise<Array<{
        entry: AgentMemoryEntry;
        score: number;
    }>>;
    candidates: AgentMemoryCandidateCapability;
    screen?(text: string): Promise<{
        hold: boolean;

        redacted: string;

    previewScope(scope: AgentMemoryEntry["scope"], owner: string): Promise<AgentMemoryScopePreview>;
    clearScope(input: {
        scope: AgentMemoryEntry["scope"];
        owner: string;
        preview: AgentMemoryScopePreview;
        operation_id: string;
        signal?: AbortSignal;
    }): Promise<AgentMemoryClearResult>;
}

export interface AgentMemoryDecisionReceipt {
    outcome: "closed" | "needs-reconcile";

        candidate_id: string;
        version: number;
    };
    target: {
        memory_id: string;
        observed_version?: number;

    };

    decision_operation_id: string;
}

export interface AgentMemoryEntry {

}

export interface AgentMemoryExtractionDraft {

        task: string;
    };

export interface AgentMemoryExtractionRequest {
    operation_id: string;
    trigger: Exclude<AgentMemoryFormationInput["trigger"], "none">;
    sources: readonly AgentMemorySourceSnapshot[];
    slots: readonly AgentMemoryFormationSlot[];
    context?: AgentMemoryFormationContext;
    limits: {
        max_sources: number;
        max_slots: number;
        max_drafts: number;
        max_source_chars: number;
        max_draft_chars: number;
        timeout_ms: number;
    };
    signal: AbortSignal;
    before_dispatch(): Promise<void>;
}

export interface AgentMemoryExtractionUsage {
    input_tokens?: number;
    output_tokens?: number;
    cached_input_tokens?: number;
}

export interface AgentMemoryExtractor {
    extract(caller: AgentMemoryCaller, input: AgentMemoryExtractionRequest): Promise<{
        drafts: readonly AgentMemoryExtractionDraft[];
        usage?: AgentMemoryExtractionUsage;
    }>;
}

export interface AgentMemoryFormationContext {
    replaying?: boolean;
    work_title?: string;
    existing: readonly {
        memory_id: string;
        version: number;
        scope: AgentMemoryEntry["scope"];
        kind: string;
        text: string;
    }[];
    pending: readonly {
        candidate_id: string;
        version: number;
        scope: AgentMemoryEntry["scope"];
        kind: string;
        text: string;
        work_title?: string | null;
        sources?: readonly AgentMemorySourceRef[];
        applies?: AgentMemoryMeta["applies_when"];
    }[];
}

export interface AgentMemoryFormationInput {
    operation_id: string;
    trigger: "none" | "explicit" | "run-end" | "session-end" | "app-scheduled";
    sources?: readonly AgentMemorySourceRef[];
    slots?: readonly AgentMemoryFormationSlot[];
    context?: AgentMemoryFormationContext;
    validate_context?(): Promise<void>;
    signal?: AbortSignal;
}

export interface AgentMemoryFormationResult {
    operation_id: string;
    outcome: "skipped" | "completed" | "partial" | "failed" | "cancelled" | "timeout" | "unavailable";
    items: readonly {
        slot_id: string;
        outcome: "created" | "replayed" | "rejected" | "unknown";
        candidate?: {
            candidate_id: string;
            version: number;
        };
        code?: string;
    }[];
    extraction: {
        calls: number;
        usage?: AgentMemoryExtractionUsage;
    };
    code?: string;
}

export interface AgentMemoryFormationSlot {
    id: string;
    scope: AgentMemoryEntry["scope"];
    owner: string;
    origin: string;
    meta: Pick<AgentMemoryMeta, "kind" | "classification" | "namespace" | "session_ref" | "expires_at_ms" | "applies_when" | "source">;
    replacement?: {
        memory_id: string;
        expected_version: number;
    };
}

export interface AgentMemoryMeta {
    classification?: {
        scenes: string[];
        lifecycle: string;
        extra?: Record<string, string[]>;
    };
    session_ref?: {
        kind: "session";
        id: string;
        revision: number;
    };
    kind?: string;
    source?: string;
    basis?: "explicit" | "repeated" | "inferred";
    applies_when?: {
        plugins?: string[];
        object_kinds?: string[];
        goals?: string[];
        task?: string;
        from_ms?: number;
        until_ms?: number;
    };
    evidence?: Array<{
        kind: string;
        text?: string;
        ref?: string;
        at_ms?: number;
    }>;
    expires_at_ms?: number;
    approved_by?: {
        by: "person";
    } | {
        by: "policy";
        policy: string;
        version: number;
    };
    namespace?: string;
}

export interface AgentMemoryMutation {
    expected_version: number;
    operation_id: string;
    signal?: AbortSignal;
}

export interface AgentMemoryPage {
    items: AgentMemoryEntry[];
    cursor?: string;
    exhausted: boolean;
    stopped: "end" | "limit" | "scan-limit" | "unknown";
    total: {
        kind: "exact";
        value: number;
    } | {
        kind: "unknown";
    };
    scanned: number | "unknown";
    cost: {
        directory_entries: number | "unknown";
        directory_enumerations: number | "unknown";
        directory_traversal: "full" | "bounded" | "unknown";
        metadata_reads: number | "unknown";
        body_reads: number | "unknown";
    };
}

export interface AgentMemoryPageQuery {
    scope: AgentMemoryEntry["scope"];
    owner: string;
    filter?: {
        namespace?: string | null;
        scenes?: readonly string[];
        kinds?: readonly string[];
        lifecycles?: readonly string[];
        extra?: Readonly<Record<string, readonly string[]>>;
        sources?: readonly string[];
        states?: readonly ("active" | "paused" | "disabled")[];
        expired?: boolean;
        tombstone?: boolean;
    };
    limit?: number;
    scan_limit?: number;
    cursor?: string;
    signal?: AbortSignal;
}

export type AgentMemoryPreviewMutation = {
    kind: "update";
    change: AgentMemoryChange;
} | {
    kind: "pause" | "disable";
    reason: string;
} | {
    kind: "resume" | "remove" | "purge";
};

export interface AgentMemoryPromotion {
    policy: string;
    version: number;
    decide(caller: AgentMemoryCaller, request: AgentMemoryPromotionRequest): "promote" | "hold" | Promise<"promote" | "hold">;
    undo: {
        prepare(caller: AgentMemoryCaller, request: AgentMemoryPromotionPreparation): Promise<void>;
        record(caller: AgentMemoryCaller, request: AgentMemoryPromotionApplied): Promise<AgentMemoryPromotionReceipt>;
    };
}

export interface AgentMemoryPromotionApplied extends AgentMemoryPromotionIdentity {
    entry: AgentMemoryEntry;
    signal?: AbortSignal;
}

export interface AgentMemoryPromotionIdentity {
    operation_id: string;
    candidate: {
        candidate_id: string;
        version: number;
    };
    policy: string;
    version: number;
}

export interface AgentMemoryPromotionPendingError extends Error {
    readonly code: "agent.memory_promotion_record_pending";
    readonly operation_id: string;
    readonly committed: {
        memory_id: string;
        version: number;
    };
}

    };

}

});

export interface AgentMemoryRecallFact {
    method: "pinned" | "recall";
    injected: Array<{
        memory_id: string;
        version: number;
    }>;
    omitted: Array<{
        memory_id: string;
        version: number;
    }>;
    unavailable: string[];
    selected?: Array<{
        memory_id: string;
        version: number;
    }>;
    retrievals?: Array<{
        receipt_id: string;
        outcome: "ready" | "none" | "skip" | "unavailable" | "failed" | "timeout" | "cancelled";
        error_code?: string;
    }>;
    contexts?: Array<{
        call_id: string;
        status: "prepared" | "not-dispatched" | "dispatched-or-unknown" | "response-observed";
        tokens: number;
        budget_tokens: number;
        basis: "conservative-estimate" | "provider-reported";
        references: Array<{
            receipt_id: string;
            memory_id: string;
            version: number;
        }>;
        parts: Array<{
            index: number;
            tokens: number;
            form: "entry" | "excerpt" | "summary";
        }>;
    }>;
    recording_error?: "memory.receipt_unrecorded";
}

        original: AgentOriginalInput;

    }>;

    readonly messages?: AgentSessionMessagesCapability;
    readonly collaboration?: AgentCollaborationPort;

    read(run: AgentRunRef): Promise<AgentRunView>;
    observe(run: AgentRunRef, listener: (view: AgentRunView) => void): () => void;
    control(run: AgentRunRef, control: AgentRunControl): Promise<void>;
    readCommandOutput(session: AgentSessionRef, ref: AgentCommandOutputRef): Promise<AgentCommandOutput>;
    readonly checkpoints?: AgentCheckpointsCapability;
    readonly skills?: AgentSkillsCapability;
    readonly skillLibrary?: AgentSkillLibrary;
    readonly mcpLibrary?: AgentMcpLibrary;
    readonly mcp?: AgentMcpCapability;
    readonly subagents?: AgentSubagentsCapability;
}

    discover(owner: AgentSkillOwner, directory: AgentWorkingDirectory, path: string): Promise<AgentSkillCandidate[]>;
    install(owner: AgentSkillOwner, candidateId: string): Promise<AgentSkillCatalogEntry>;
}

export interface AgentSkillOwner {
    project_id: string;
    plugin_id: string;
}

export interface AgentSkillRef {
    skill_id: string;
    version: number;
}

export interface AgentSkillsCapability {
    catalog(session: AgentSessionRef): Promise<AgentSkillCatalogEntry[]>;
}

export interface AgentStartExecution extends ActionCallOrigin {
    beforeStart?(): void | Promise<void>;
    assertBeforeStart?(): void;
    beforeDispatch?(): void | Promise<void>;
}

    role?: AgentFrozenRole;
};

export type AgentStepAmendment = {
    kind: "skip";
    node: string;
    reason: string;
} | {
    kind: "insert";
    after: string;
    title: string;
    acceptance: string;
    mine?: true;
    origin?: string;
} | {
    kind: "unblock";
    node: string;
    note: string;
} | {
    kind: "move";
    node: string;
    direction: "up" | "down";
} | {
    kind: "assign";
    node: string;
    to: "me" | "session";
} | {
    kind: "resolve";
    node: string;
    state: "succeeded" | "failed";
    note: string;
};

export interface AgentStepBoard {
    project_id: string;

        id: string;
        state: "not-started" | "ready" | "running" | "waiting" | "succeeded" | "failed" | "cancelled" | "blocked" | "needs-reconciliation";
        reports: Array<{
            note: string;
            at_ms: number;
            by?: string;
            handover?: true;
            inputs?: import("@molis-ai/molis-work-contracts/services/agent-inputs").AgentInputRef[];
        }>;
        owner?: AgentStepOwner;
        title?: string;
        depends_on?: string[];
        inserted?: boolean;
        origins?: import("@molis-ai/molis-work-contracts/services/agent-inputs").AgentInputRef[];
    }>;
}

        session_id: string;
        error: string;
    }>>;

        session_id?: string;

        items: AgentProjectWork[];
        overlaps: AgentProjectWorkOverlap[];
    }>;
    readonly readMessages: ActionDefinition<[runtimeId: string, sessionId?: string], AgentSessionMessage[]>;

        notified: string[];
        paths: string[];
    }>;
    readonly sendPeopleMessage: ActionDefinition<[runtimeId: string, input: AgentPeopleMessageInput], AgentSessionMessage>;

        event?: string;
        note?: string;
        attachments?: AgentMessageAttachment[];
    }], AgentSessionMessage>;
    readonly cancelMessage: ActionDefinition<[runtimeId: string, messageId: string], void>;

        session: AgentSessionRef;
        directory: string;
        task: string;
        after: string;
        title?: string;
    }], AgentProjectWork>;
    readonly awaitContinuations: ActionDefinition<[runtimeId: string, timeoutMs: number, exclude?: string[]], AgentCollaborationSessionView[]>;
    readonly readBackground: ActionDefinition<[runtimeId: string, sessionId?: string], AgentBackgroundTask[]>;

    readonly releaseProjectRound: ActionDefinition<[runtimeId: string, workId: string, note: string], void>;
    readonly listSkills: ActionDefinition<[runtimeId: string], AgentSkillCatalogEntry[]>;

    readonly discoverSkills: ActionDefinition<[runtimeId: string, directory: AgentWorkingDirectory, path: string], AgentSkillCandidate[]>;
    readonly installSkill: ActionDefinition<[runtimeId: string, candidateId: string], AgentSkillCatalogEntry>;
    readonly listMcp: ActionDefinition<[runtimeId: string], AgentMcpServerView[]>;
    readonly saveMcp: ActionDefinition<[runtimeId: string, input: AgentMcpServerInput], AgentMcpServerView>;
    readonly controlMcp: ActionDefinition<[runtimeId: string, id: string, action: "connect" | "disconnect" | "cancel" | "remove"], void>;
    readonly startRun: ActionDefinition<[runtimeId: string, input: AgentStartInput], AgentRunHandle>;
    readonly readRun: ActionDefinition<[session: AgentSessionRef, run: AgentRunRef], AgentRunView>;
    readonly draftText: ActionDefinition<AgentDraftTextRequest, AgentDraftTextResult>;
    readonly waitRun: ActionDefinition<[session: AgentSessionRef, run: AgentRunRef, since: string | null, timeoutMs: number], {
        version: string;
        view: AgentRunView;
    }>;
    readonly controlRun: ActionDefinition<[session: AgentSessionRef, run: AgentRunRef, control: AgentRunControl], void>;
    readonly readCommandOutput: ActionDefinition<[session: AgentSessionRef, ref: AgentCommandOutputRef], AgentCommandOutput>;
    readonly inspectRecovery: ActionDefinition<[session: AgentSessionRef], AgentRecoveryReport>;
    readonly recoverRun: ActionDefinition<[session: AgentSessionRef, run: AgentRunRef, expectedVersion: number], AgentRecoveryReport>;
    readonly listCheckpoints: ActionDefinition<[session: AgentSessionRef], AgentCheckpoint[]>;
